body: I tried to participate in helping the server by making a map for it, but it doesnt seem like its good enough to be used, anyways what I was thinking of is that if someone can use my idea, in world war the turkish army used tunnels to hide in from artillery and enemy fire, they also used to set traps and live in small rooms, I think it would be fun to have a map where most of it is in the hills with tunnels in it :)
